name: BCO BIL.VIZ.ARG.ADR EO,-4
summary: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. (BBVA) is a global financial services group offering a wide range of banking and financial products and services to individuals, businesses, and institutions. The company operates through retail banking, corporate and investment banking, asset management, and insurance segments, and is headquartered in Bilbao, Spain. BBVA has a significant presence in Spain, Mexico, South America, and Turkey.
